title: Interpretation
description: The items in one capture. Copy words from the capture; never work out a date or a number.

items.description: One entry per separate thing to do, pay, send, wait for, meet about, decide or note. At most six.

quote.description: The first words of the sentence of the capture this item comes from, copied exactly, at most twelve words.

title.description: A short title for the item.

action.description: What has to happen: call, pay, send, review, wait for someone else, file, meet, decide, note, or other.

when_text.description: The time words exactly as spoken, or an empty string when there are none.

people.description: People named for this item, exactly as spoken. Empty when none.

amount_text.description: The money amount exactly as spoken, or an empty string when there is none.
